communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.thread: How does a Dev's job look like in a few years? (8pts, 12 comments)
communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.whyGenuine: Open-ended future-of-work question; terminalblog has 'Most Teams Aren't Ready for What Coding Agents Do Next' and 'The Hidden Cost of AI Coding Agents' that genuinely answer it.
communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.suggestedReply: My team's experience matches the anxiety in this thread, but the real friction isn't 'will my job exist' — it's that most eng orgs don't have the process to safely hand autonomy to an agent (review, rollout, blast-radius limits). The token/retry cost side is the part nobody budgets for: https://terminalblog.com/blog/real-cost-of-ai-coding-agents/
